recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of three women in a triangular composition, wearing plush fur coats against a stark white background, featuring a distinctive oval logo and arched typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of faces creating a tight focal cluster
Contrast between dark hair/makeup and light-colored fur textures
Balance between the organic curves of the subjects and the geometric oval logo
Warm skin tones against a clinical white negative space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the left two-thirds of the frame, stacked vertically and horizontally to form a cluster.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central face in the lower-middle foreground acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top face down to the bottom two, then sweep right to the logo and text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space on the right side provides breathing room for typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for high-contrast isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in hair and fur for structural depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Creamy beige and tan tones in the coats; bold red/berry lip color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value overall with localized high saturation in the makeup and warm skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm, earthy secondary palette

letterConstructionRules: Primary logo uses heavy, fluid script with thick strokes and rounded terminals
Secondary text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with significant letter spacing
Text follows arched paths (concave and convex)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initials are interlocking or tightly kerned within an oval container
Sans-serif characters are flattened and extended
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a fluid, heavy script logo against a rigid, wide-spaced geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Solid black oval background for the main logo
Arched text paths creating a circular motion

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, heavy weight of the central logo
Matches the wide, technical feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of three women with 90s hairstyles and makeup, wearing textured fur coats in shades of cream and brown, clustered together on the left side of a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black oval in the upper right. Inside the oval, place heavy script initials in cream. Above and below the oval, add arched sans-serif text in black with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Are the coats visibly textured and plush?
Is the typography arched around the central oval?
Does the makeup reflect a 90s glamour aesthetic?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the triangular composition is maintained
Verify the high-key white background is clean
Confirm the arched text follows the oval's curvature
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + triangular grouping + fur textures + high-key white space + arched geometric typography.
